summary: No installer-harm indicators observed in veskra@1.0.0
details: veskra@1.0.0 contains six files with no static or behavioral indicators of supply-chain attack: no lifecycle scripts fetching remote content, no credential or environment scraping, no hardcoded exfiltration endpoints, no obfuscated payloads, and no dropper patterns. No attacker-controlled network destinations were identified.
